coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Fonseca's and Galvis-Florez's results are operation counts in prose and stay LOW. Gabbassov's counts are LOW; the energy-gap bound is LOW because the optimality of the dual multipliers is not quoted. Gacon: the definitions of the QNG, McLachlan and DualQTE updates, the DualQTE local convexity, the SPSA gradient proof, the QGT eigenvalue bound, the variational-principle comparison, the TDVP counterexample, the McLachlan two-form derivation, the imaginary-time convergence results and the Fubini-Study proof are quoted with their conditions and stay HIGH. The Appendix E sampling bounds are LOW: their derivations drop higher-order terms, use first-order approximations, and lose square roots in the text layer; the DualQTE bound also rests on an empirical constant K. The reader's flag on 'cited' items graded high was checked: each main-text statement is graded on its own quotes. Georgiou's Theorems 2 to 5 are LOW because their bounds are garbled in the text layer and not quoted
